caption: The drawing depicts a four-poster canopy bed positioned against a wooden wall. The bed has tall, brown wooden posts supporting a rectangular canopy draped with cream-colored fabric adorned with white floral or dot patterns and finished at the edges with small white fringes or pom-poms. The bed is dressed in white bedcovers with a faint yellow floral motif, and a pale yellow blanket lies folded at the foot of the bed, with a round, shallow bowl containing red and yellow objects placed on top of the blanket. The floor and background area around the bed are rendered in brown and beige tones, consistent with the wooden wall and floor. The curtains attached to the canopy hang partially open, showing more of the bed’s interior, and both the curtains and the skirt around the base of the bed echo the decorative bobble trim seen on the canopy.
title: Bedroom of House
